Source : enquête d'identité des Organisa: Source: community-based organisation identity survey (34 records, 8 of 10 communal sections). The unit is the organisation, not the household. No breakdown by sex, age or economic group is possible: the communal-section value is carried over to every sub-population.
Part des organisations communautaires qu: Share of community organisations that work with at least one other organisation. Isolated organisations depend on their own resources alone when a shock hits.
Part des organisations contribuant à des: Share of organisations contributing to private-sector or civil-society initiatives. Measures whether community groups are part of the wider local economy rather than working apart from it.
Part des organisations en relation de tr: Share of organisations in working contact with the communal authorities. Where this link is absent, community initiatives and public action are unlikely to reinforce each other.
Part des organisations soumettant des ra: Share of organisations submitting activity reports to an external body. Reporting practice is one of the few observable signs that an organisation is accountable to someone.
Part des organisations disposant d'une l: Share of organisations holding an up-to-date list of the development actors working on their territory. Knowing who does what is the condition for coordination.
Part des organisations ayant reçu un app: Share of organisations having received external support, training, funding or equipment. Measures whether outside resources actually reach the local level.
Part des organisations reliées à des ONG: Share of organisations connected to international NGOs. In the social-capital literature this is linking capital: the ties that bring in resources a community does not hold itself.
Part des organisations ayant compté une: Share of organisations that have had a woman in a leadership position. Where decisions are taken without women, the needs they carry tend not to reach the agenda.
Share of organisations that have had someone aged 18 to 30 in a leadership position. An indication of whether the organisation renews itself or ages with its founders.
Nombre d'organisations communautaires re: Number of community organisations recorded in the section. Below three, there is no associative fabric to speak of, a shock leaves households facing it individually.
Naissances enregistrées à l'état civil: Births registered with the civil registry
Lien plausible, mécanisme indirect, aucu: Plausible link, indirect mechanism, no measurement.
Mécanisme direct, mais effet faible ou t: Direct mechanism, but small or highly context-dependent.
Effet régulièrement observé, d'ampleur m: Regularly observed effect, moderate size, several contexts.
Mécanisme direct, sources convergentes,: Direct mechanism, converging sources, first-order effect.
Relation structurelle : l'un est une con: Structural relation: one is a condition or a component of the other.
Structurelle — l'un conditionne l'autre: Structural — one conditions the other by construction.
Empirique — taille d'effet mesurée dans: Empirical — effect size measured in a source that was opened and checked.
Documentée — établie par la littérature: Documented — established by the literature or an institutional source.
Théorique — déduite du cadre IRLA, sans: Theoretical — derived from the IRLA framework, unmeasured.
Hypothèse — posée par le modèle, à confi: Hypothesis — posed by the model, to confirm or drop.
Réhabiliter les points d'eau existants a: Rehabilitate the existing water points before building new ones: in most sections the problem is not the absence of a structure but the broken structure. Capping and protecting upstream springs, household treatment where the source stays distant, and a user committee per point with a maintenance fund topped up monthly. No handover without a trained local repairer and spare parts held at communal level.
Sortir de la défécation à l'air libre pa: Move away from open defecation through community-led sanitation rather than latrine handouts: a third of households still practise open defecation and a third of existing latrines are pits without a slab. Fund the slab and the ventilation, not the superstructure, which households build, and tie each campaign to the water points of the same watershed.
Rompre le lien entre pauvreté et charbon: Break the poverty-charcoal link at both ends: improved stoves produced locally and sold on short credit, and substitute income for those who cut wood to live. A stove campaign with no income alternative moves the cutting, it does not reduce it.
Privilégier le solaire domestique et les: Favour household solar and community mini-grids: extending the national grid is not on the horizon for these sections. Target collective points first — health centre, school, motorised water point — where electrification benefits the whole section rather than one household.
Renforcer l'existant plutôt que reconstr: Strengthen what stands rather than rebuild: roof anchoring, bracing, masonry repair, on houses that stand but do not hold in wind. Train local masons in the few practices that make the difference in a hurricane, and make them identifiable in each section.
Là où l'école est à plus de trente minut: Where school is more than thirty minutes away, act on the road as much as on the building: culverted crossings, safe crossing points in the rainy season, and a canteen, which weighs more on attendance than distance itself.
Compléter le maillage par des agents de: Complete the network with community health workers rather than new centres: one trained and supplied worker per section covers first recourse, antenatal follow-up and referral. Plan for emergency transport, which is the real breaking point in the mountains.
Utiliser la couverture mobile existante: Use existing mobile coverage as alert and transfer infrastructure: it is the only network that already reaches most households. Negotiate free broadcast of alert messages with operators and access to mobile financial services in the least covered sections.
Rapprocher l'eau du foyer libère d'abord: Bringing water closer to the home first frees women's time: each additional water point returns hours that go back to the garden, to school and to activity. Measuring that time before and after, section by section, turns it into a visible result rather than an assumed effect.
Boucler la chaîne d'alerte jusqu'au dern: Close the alert chain to the last kilometre: the message exists, it does not arrive. Relay by SMS, by community radio and by a named focal point in each locality, with one drill per season to check that the message truly travels.
Consolider les comités locaux de gestion: Consolidate local risk management committees where they exist and create them where they are missing, with a written mandate, a contingency plan per section and a small maintenance budget. A committee with no resources of its own becomes a list of names again within eighteen months.
Faire de la préparation un exercice coll: Make preparedness a collective exercise rather than a training: an annual drill before the hurricane season, mapping of shelters and of people to evacuate first, drawn by residents themselves and posted in the section.
Le contrôle forestier ne tiendra pas par: Forest control will not hold through enforcement: support locally negotiated use agreements between residents, landowners and communal authorities, with monitors from the sections themselves and compensation for land put under protection.
Organiser des audiences foraines d'enreg: Run mobile registration sessions in remote sections rather than waiting for trips to the town centre, and couple birth registration with vaccination and school enrolment, which already bring families in.
La carte d'identité conditionne le compt: The identity card conditions the account, the transfers and the services: organise its issuance on site, one day per section, with communal authorities. It is the cheapest formality to remove and the one that unlocks the most downstream.
La satisfaction envers les services publ: Satisfaction with public services is built through presence and accountability: posting what is planned, a quarterly feedback meeting in each section, and visible handling of complaints. What is seen is believed.
Restaurer le couvert par des essences ut: Restore cover with species useful to households, fruit and timber trees, planted on plots whose use is secured: nobody plants a tree on land they may lose. Pair protected areas with in-kind compensation for the first year.
Produire du bois plutôt que d'en interdi: Grow wood rather than ban its cutting: short-rotation village woodlots, live hedges and agroforestry on cultivated plots. The resource comes back where it pays the person who tends it.
Réduire la pression sur le bois-énergie: Reduce pressure on fuelwood by acting on demand — improved stoves, densified charcoal — and on the income of those who live from it. As long as cutting remains the income of last resort, pressure returns after every campaign.
Traiter les ravines par des ouvrages sim: Treat gullies with many simple structures rather than a few heavy ones: dry-stone check dams, fascines, grass strips, built labour-intensively during the lean season, which also brings income.
Retenir l'eau là où elle tombe : rigoles: Hold the water where it falls: infiltration ditches, family cisterns, ponds developed at the head of the watershed. It is the cheapest answer to a drought named as the first cause of falling yields.
Reconstituer la fertilité par la matière: Rebuild fertility with the organic matter available on site: compost, manure, green manure and mulching, rather than bought inputs that the next season cannot afford to buy again.
Diffuser les pratiques conservatrices pa: Spread conservation practices through farmer field schools and lead farmers rather than classroom sessions: more than half of those who farm have no water source to irrigate, and it is around plot-level water retention that the demonstration convinces.
Sécuriser la campagne avant d'augmenter: Secure the season before raising yields: seed adapted to short cycles, storage that limits post-harvest losses, and water access at plot level. A yield gain lost in storage is not a gain.
Protéger les milieux qui rendent un serv: Protect the environments that render a visible service to residents — mangroves, spring heads, fishing areas — through local management agreements with a clear use right, rather than perimeters imposed from outside.
La santé de la végétation se lit par sat: Vegetation health is read by satellite but decided at plot level: soil cover in the dry season, windbreak hedges and trees within crops. Satellite monitoring then serves to verify what the plots did, not to replace it.
On ne pilote pas l'aridité, on s'y prépa: Aridity is not steered, it is prepared for: adjusted cropping calendars, short-cycle varieties, water reserves and food stocks built before the dry season. The indicator serves as an alert, not as a target.
La pluie ne se pilote pas : ce qui se pi: Rainfall is not steered: what is steered is what is retained from it and what is anticipated. Couple radio-broadcast seasonal information with sowing decisions, and hold the water of intense episodes rather than endure it.
La sécurité foncière conditionne tout in: Land tenure security conditions every long-term investment: support the recognition of use rights at communal level, written agreements between parties before witnesses, and conflict settlement through local mediation before judicial recourse.
S'appuyer sur les mutuelles de solidarit: Build on the savings mutuals already named by respondents rather than importing a scheme: support to existing groups, mobile accounts backed by the identity card, and financial education carried by the women's groups that already run them.
Constituer une réserve avant la crise pl: Build a reserve before the crisis rather than relief after it: group savings with a seasonal target, a community food stock, and index insurance if the product becomes available. Seven in ten households have no cushion outside land.
Diversifier hors de la seule agriculture: Diversify beyond rainfed farming alone: processing of local products, small livestock, repair trades tied to the structures being installed. Every funded structure should leave a trade behind it in the section.
Créer de l'emploi par les travaux à haut: Create employment through labour-intensive works that also build resilience: gully treatment, tracks, reforestation, planned in the lean season and paid on time, which matters as much as the amount.
Les transferts existent et arrivent mal: Transfers exist and arrive badly: ease access to withdrawal points and mobile accounts so that money sent is not eaten by the journey. It is a gain with no new funding.
Traiter la privation alimentaire par le: Address food deprivation through income and stock rather than distribution: two households in three skipped a meal, and the gap between economic groups is stark. Community granaries, seasonal savings, and distribution reserved for peaks.
La santé se joue ici sur l'eau, l'assain: Health here turns on water, sanitation and distance to care: act on the three together in the same sections rather than separately in three programmes, and connect the coverage achieved to the cases recorded by health facilities.
La capacité de travail est le produit de: Capacity to work is the product of health, water and food: it is not targeted directly, it is harvested. It is, however, the right indicator to check that a set of interventions produced something other than structures.
L'achèvement du primaire tient à la cant: Primary completion turns on the canteen, the cost of supplies and the distance: act on the three, and track girls separately, because that is where early exit happens.
Le tissu associatif est mince là où il s: The associational fabric is thin where it would be most useful: support existing organisations before creating new ones, with a small running fund, a place to meet and bookkeeping training, and make their presence a targeting criterion.
L'entraide existe déjà et ne se décrète: Mutual aid already exists and cannot be decreed: recognise it by entrusting local groups with a structure, a stock or a fund, which gives it an object rather than a discourse.
Le capital de passerelle est ce qui reli: Bridging capital is what connects a section to the outside: support federations of organisations, links with communal authorities and exchanges between sections, which circulate what works.
Le sentiment de sécurité conditionne l'i: The sense of safety conditions investment and mobility: lighting of collective points, mediation of land conflicts and the visible presence of local authorities weigh more here than formal arrangements.
La sensibilisation ne change les pratiqu: Awareness changes practices only if it is carried by peers and backed by a means: couple each message with access to the equipment or the credit that makes the change possible, otherwise you inform without enabling.
Le maintien sur place ne se décrète pas,: Staying in place cannot be decreed, it is derived: it is the result of water, income and school. It serves as a summary indicator to check that a programme made the place liveable, not as a target to hit.
Un abri ne se décrète pas le jour du cyc: A shelter is not decided on the day of the storm: it is chosen in calm weather, with the CASEC and the school that hosts it, and checked every year. Rehabilitate the buildings already designated rather than build new ones, give them water, separate latrines and an emergency stock, and publish the list per communal section with the route to reach it. A shelter without water empties in two days.
Le charbon se coupe parce qu'il se vend,: Charcoal is cut because it sells, and our survey shows it is used more as income rises: this is a market, not an isolated act of survival. Acting on its profitability means regulating sale points and transport rather than chasing cutters, supporting improved carbonisation where it will remain whole families' livelihood, and making gas and efficient stoves cheaper to use than a bag of charcoal. A ban with no income alternative simply moves the trade to the next section.
Le brûlis est une technique, pas une nég: Slash-and-burn is a technique, not carelessness: it clears a plot fast with no tools and no wages. It goes away only if another work calendar is offered, mulching and cover crops, and if firebreaks and authorised periods are organised with the farmers themselves rather than by decree. Community brigades per section, with simple tools and a phone number that answers, cost less than replanting one hillside twice.
La pression sur la terre ne se traite pa: Pressure on land is not addressed through demography but through what pushes people to open one more plot: no title, no work off the field, and families displaced from elsewhere coming back. Secure existing uses, support activities that need no new surface, processing, fishing, services, and plan for displaced households in communal plans, otherwise they will settle on the slopes.
